description: Source code for UsecaseValidator implementation in Android media framework, managing audio stream registration, unregistration, and attribute verification.

classes.name: UsecaseValidatorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UsecaseValidator interface, handling stream registration, unregistration, and attribute validation.

methods.name: registerStream
methods.description: Registers a new audio stream with specific flags and attributes.

methods.name: startClient
methods.description: Marks the start of playback activity on a stream and verifies audio attributes.

methods.name: stopClient
methods.description: Marks the stopping of playback activity on a stream.

methods.name: verifyAudioAttributes
methods.description: Verifies and potentially updates audio attributes for a stream based on usage, content type, flags, and whether it's a game stream.

methods.name: isUsageValid
methods.description: Checks if the usage type of audio attributes is valid.

methods.name: isContentTypeValid
methods.description: Checks if the content type of audio attributes is valid.

methods.name: areFlagsValid
methods.description: Checks if the flags set on the audio stream are valid.
